checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13, all volumes within pipette ranges (40–200 µL multi, 250 µL/400 µL mix on p1000), waste wells peak ~1.54 mL of 2.4 mL, reservoir columns within 15 mL (check passed), simulation passed.

Check fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact passed (48 distinct tips); reagent tips are shared only while dispensing at destination.top(2) and never touch samples; every tip is dropped and removal/elution/recovery use a fresh tip per column.

All 17 checks passed; code follows the steps in order: 4 °C and magnet off first, 40/250/250 µL, 5× mix, 5 min delay, 4 min magnet, 540 µL removal, two 500 µL ethanol washes, 4 min dry, elution, 30 s, 90 s, 80 µL recovery, final disengage.
Checks 48_samples_to_odd_columns and distinct_elution_wells passed; samples are mapped one to one to extraction wells and then to the matching elution plate column.
Beads 40, then isopropanol 125×2, then sample 250 µL with mix(5, 400); 5 min delay, magnet.engage(), 4 min delay, then 3×180 µL removal to waste with magnet on (checks passed).
Two ethanol washes of 200+200+100 µL, each removed with magnet engaged; 4 min delay with magnet engaged, then magnet.disengage() before elution (two_500ul_ethanol_washes and air_dry_4min passed).
Magnet disengaged, 100 µL elution added and mixed 10×, 30 s delay, engage, 90 s delay, then 80 µL recovered into distinct elution plate wells at 4 °C (checks passed).

judge.summary: The protocol simulates cleanly and passes all 17 measured run-log checks. The code implements every specified step in order, with fresh tips wherever a tip touches a sample well, so every rubric item scores 1.
